title: Kuba Filipowski (Netguru co-founder) — in the AI era, 'the artifact is not the point' (Eric Ries)
summary: Kuba Filipowski — co-founder of Netguru — publishes a sharp AI-era reframing of Lean Startup + Incorruptible: the unit of progress isn't code Claude Code generates for you; it's validated learning.
blockquote: When people say 'I want to build an MVP,' they now think: 'Claude Code will build it for me.' Eric Ries says: the artifact is not the point. The author of The Lean Startup and Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad... and How Great Companies Stay Great notes that even the Agile manifesto says the unit of progress is working code. Lean Startup goes further – the real unit of progress is validated learning.
